Enter a public X / Twitter post link to download its videos or GIFs.
GIFs on X are usually provided as MP4 videos. The download keeps the video file. Select “Video to GIF” on the results screen to choose a frame rate and size, then convert it.
Downloads use the app\'s output storage settings. If automatic saving is enabled, they are also saved to your selected storage folder.
